summary: Fortuna Mining Corp. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to report its publication of the 2025 Sustainability Report under cover of Exhibit 99.1. The report covers governance, operational performance, health and safety, community relations, and environmental metrics, including 0.00 LTIFR and zero significant environmental spills. No transaction, restructuring, activist campaign, or strategic review is announced; the filing is a routine disclosure of sustainability progress. The registrant is a Canadian foreign private issuer. This document is a non-event periodic update with no special-situation implications.
